question: The diameter of base of a right circular cone is 20 cm and its slant height is 10.5 cm. What is the curved surface area (in cm²) of the right circular cone? [Use π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
Given:

The diameter of the base of a right circular cone is 20 cm and its slant height is 10.5 cm

Concept used:

Diameter = Radius × 2

Curved surface area = πrl

where r = radius of the base and l = slant height

Calculation:

The radius of the base of a right circular cone = 20 ÷ 2 = 10 cm

Hence, the curved surface area of the right circular cone

⇒ π × 10 × 10.5

⇒ 330 cm²

∴ The curved surface area of the right circular cone is 330 cm².
